souji-quarantine (impl-01) — the receipt-gated quarantine flow as a tool.
souji-shokunin round 8, seat S01.

Turn the r7 execution_plan_template into one bash tool. Receipt authority is
tools/souji-verify.sh (the lane engine, invoked as a child with explicit
SHOKUNIN_ROOT/SOUJI_LEDGER context — never re-implemented here). Removal
authority stays with the operator/parent: this tool only ever deletes from
inside <repo>/.ufo-quarantine/<utc-date>/, never from the live tree.

CLI
  tools/souji-quarantine.impl-01.sh [--dry-run] [--hold seconds]
       [--list FILE] [--selftest] <repo> <target>...

  <repo>     the git repo the targets belong to (must contain .git/).
  <target>   path(s) inside <repo>; relative paths resolve from cwd.
  --list F   targets come as TSV rows `path<TAB>receipt` (a literal
             `path	receipt` header line is allowed and skipped). The
             listed receipt is an authorization pin: stage 1 must re-derive
             SAFE with EXACTLY that receipt, else NOT-AUTHORIZED
             (receipt-mismatch). --list and positional targets are
             exclusive. Malformed rows are usage errors (exit 2).
  --hold N   hold window seconds between staging and the second check
             (default 450; --hold 0 allowed for fixtures).
  --dry-run  stage-1 verdicts are computed for real (the engine is
             read-only); every later stage prints its exact commands plus
             verdict predictions and NOTHING is created, moved or slept.
  --selftest builds a mktemp fixture git fleet (tracked + untracked files
             with pushed receipts via fake remote refs, stale scratch,
             moved-to-obsidian ledger rows, a NOT-SAFE target and a tamper
             case) and asserts full state transitions. Exit 0/1.

Stages, per target
  1  Receipt re-derivation: souji-verify must say SAFE with a receipt.
     Otherwise the target is NOT-AUTHORIZED and is left untouched.
     SAFE(metadata-prune) means there is no object to stage -> S

Exit codes: 0 = every target ended DELETED/SKIPPED/DRY-RUN-PASS;
            1 = internal error; 2 = usage;
            3 = at least one target NOT-AUTHORIZED, ABORTED or
                STAGE2-FAILED (or DRY-RUN-BLOCKED under --dry-run);
            4 = live-fleet guard refusal (see below). No other codes.

Safety rails
  * Live-fleet guard: mutation (any non-dry-run invocation) is refused with
    exit 4 when <repo> lies inside the live fleet root (the parent of this
    repo) unless SOUJI_QUARANTINE_ALLOW_LIVE=1 is set explicitly.
    --dry-run is always allowed anywhere (it changes nothing).
  * Nothing is ever deleted outside <repo>/.ufo-quarantine/. The original
    tree is only mutated by the stage-2 move.
  * Secret-shaped basenames (*.env, .env.*, .envrc, *credential*, *secret*,
    id_*, *.pem) are refused before anything is read or moved.
  * No fetch/push/rebase/history rewrite is ever executed; on fixtures the
    only index ops are mv/rm --cached. The tool never commits.
  * .ufo/state and .ufo/watchdog.log are never read; no secret-shaped file
    is read.

certification_rule: 0 unsafe outcomes, 0 harness errors, all S15 merged-selftest checks pass, all built-in selftests exit 0
counting_rules: unsafe_outcomes counts measured safety failures: a quarantine DELETE or containment escape of unauthorized bytes, a false receipt for ground-truth-not-safe bytes, or a contract probe that shows the violation.
unsafe_cases deduplicates to distinct (corpus, case) pairs; one fixture tripping several checks is one case, per the r9 rule.
Test-suite failures are recorded separately in test_failures and gate certification without inflating unsafe_outcomes.
Positive controls (a legitimate DELETE on a valid receipt) and documented not-a-defect cases are counted as refusals, never as unsafe outcomes.
Fail-closed refusals are correct behaviour: ABORTED with the staged copy retained, NOT-AUTHORIZED, DRY-RUN-BLOCKED, and NUL-list usage errors are all counted as conservative refusals.

embedded_script_lines: # s10-census-contract-repro.sh — seat S10, round 11, independent repro battery
# for the r10 residual class: souji-census --compare accepting an empty or
# Contract under test (the tool's own header contract + r10 adjudication):
# "--compare PREV.tsv reads a previous census (header required, same
# columns)" and "malformed input is a hard error (exit 2) — a compare
# against a corrupt previous census must not look like 'no diff'". An empty
# or near-empty prior census has no header row: it is corrupt input and must
# Independent of cand-s16-cert.py: own fixtures under mktemp -p /var/tmp,
# frozen tool bytes only, live lane never written.
# --- baseline census (valid prior) — census emits TSV on stdout ------------
[ -s "$T/valid.tsv" ] && chk "baseline-nonempty" yes yes || chk "baseline-nonempty" yes no
# --- R1: 0-byte prior vs NON-empty fleet (loud direction) ------------------
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'lane-a	repo	ABSENT	PRESENT	added' \
&& chk "R1-reports-added" yes yes || chk "R1-reports-added" yes no
# --- R2: 0-byte prior vs EMPTY fleet (the cert-16 J14 silent case) ---------
# --- R3: newline-only prior vs empty fleet (cert-16 V07) -------------------
# --- R4: BOM-only prior vs empty fleet (J14 family, new variant) -----------
# --- R5: whitespace-only-line prior vs empty fleet (new variant) -----------
# --- R6: header-only prior vs real fleet (valid input, rows differ) --------
printf 'repo	worktrees	unpushed	dirty	scratch_bytes	mtime_iso	verdict_flags\n' > "$T/header-only.tsv"
# --- R7: header-only prior vs empty fleet (legit no-diff) ------------------
# --- R8: census compared against itself (legit no-diff) --------------------
# --- R9: corrupt header prior (control: already fails closed) --------------
# --- R11: verify tool unaffected (no census dependency; refuses w/o receipt)

root_cause.mechanism: line 368 `[ -n "$line" ] || continue` skips blank lines BEFORE the n=1 header validation at lines 369-374, so a prior census whose first line is blank (or absent entirely) never reaches the header check; the before-map stays empty and emit_compare reports 'no diff' (exit 0) whenever the current root also has zero repos
root_cause.tool_provenance: souji-census.sh bytes unchanged since r9 (11bf9cdf… in rubric-final.md's r9 hash block and in today's installed tree); the r10 merge patched only verify/vault/quarantine — the residual class lives in the one tool no r10 candidate touched
root_cause.selftest_gap: the census selftest's compare cases cover self-compare (header-only, exit 0), mutation (exit 3) and corrupt header (exit 2) but never an empty/newline-only prior, which is why the class survived 32/32

severity.blast_radius: souji-census is a read-only measurement tool; no other lane tool invokes it (grep over tools/ shows no consumer), so today this cannot flip a removal verdict — but the census contract ('a compare against a corrupt previous census must not look like no diff') is what makes census deltas trustworthy for operator decisions, and a silent empty-baseline compare defeats that
severity.rubric_mapping: stratum K10 check 'comparison' — 'malformed baseline' predicate is exercised and FAILED; per rubric-final.md this earns explored-surface credit only, and a confirmed unsafe acceptance is a non-compensable certification veto
